confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Aix pricing and July demand around the Festival d'Aix; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is most sensitive to festival-period rates. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.1x and 1.2x). Euro-based reasoning used an assumed 1.16 USD/EUR planning rate, not a live quote. The FX value was taken from RBA exchange-rate pages as reported in search results; the F11.1 file was not directly confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized southern French tourist cities such as Avignon, Arles and Montpellier, adjusted upward for Aix's cafe-terrace pricing and July festival demand.
